title: Travel: John Lennon – San Francisco to New York City | 1974
content:
John Lennon and May Pang flew from San Francisco to New York City on 23 September 1974.

They had spent four days in California for Lennon to promote the Walls And Bridges album, in press interviews and radio appearances.
